# Getting Support

If you need help with Atlas:

1. **Read the docs first:** https://docs.atlasos.net
   - Installation guide: https://docs.atlasos.net/getting-started/installation/
   - Post‑install configuration: https://docs.atlasos.net/getting-started/post-installation/atlas-folder/
   - FAQ: https://docs.atlasos.net/general-faq/
2. **Search existing issues:** https://github.com/Atlas-OS/Atlas/issues
3. **Join Discord** for live community help: https://discord.atlasos.net
4. **Start a Discussion** for ideas / questions: https://github.com/Atlas-OS/Atlas/discussions
5. **Open a bug report** (using the template) only when you have something
   reproducible. Please attach the output of
   `%windir%\AtlasModules\Scripts\Diagnostics\Export-AtlasDiagnostics.ps1`.

> **Do not** open GitHub issues for general "how do I..." questions — Discord
> or Discussions are the right place.
